musicPrompt: Sleek, minimal launch-film electronic bed for a 60-second tech short, about 110 BPM, soft synth pulses, airy pads, light clicky percussion, calm and confident, a small lift around the trick at 30 seconds and a calm resolve into the end card, instrumental, no vocals.

scenes.text: Claude can code you a whole video. Changing it means digging through the code.
Welcome to Claude Skills, by Curiously.
We asked Claude for a title card in Remotion, with and without Remotion's own skills.
Plain Claude already knows Remotion. But its timing hid in raw frame numbers: frame eight, five frames apart.
With the skills, each line got a name, with its timing in seconds written right on it.
That's the trick. Remotion Studio can edit code written this way by hand: drag a line, move a keyframe, and it saves the change back into your code.
The catch: you need Node and a Remotion project, and companies over three people need a paid Remotion licence.
Building videos with Claude? It's one command. Link in the description.
If you like this kind of content, like, share and follow Curiously.
